# MD_RENDER

> A markdown renderer for macOS and Linux built on Tauri 2 (Rust + React). It sets `.md`/`.markdown` files in book typography with nine themes, a heading index, KaTeX math, Mermaid diagrams, syntax highlighting, review comments stored in the file, charts of trackio experiment logs from `<plot>` blocks, and tabs across several documents. The same binary runs as a desktop window or, with `--port`, as a localhost HTTP server with identical capabilities — including editing and saving — which makes it usable over an SSH port-forward from a headless machine.

Key facts:

- CLI: `mdrender [FILE|DIR]...` starts a server on port 9999 (or joins the one there), opens the first document in the browser and returns with the server running in the background (no argument: the current directory); `mdrender --app [FILE|DIR]...` opens the desktop window instead; `mdrender --port [PORT] [FILE|DIR]...` serves in the foreground with no browser (port defaults to 9999, falling forward to the next free port when another program holds it; valid range 1–65535). The binary flag behind the default is `--open`; `MDRENDER_BROWSER` names the opener (empty disables it), `MDRENDER_BIN` the executable, `MDRENDER_FOREGROUND=1` keeps the default mode in the foreground. Directory arguments expand to every markdown file beneath them, one tab each. Each directory (or a file's parent directory) is a workspace at `http://127.0.0.1:PORT/<dirname>/` with its own tab set; the root URL redirects to the only workspace or lists them.
- Running `mdrender FILE` (or `mdrender --port FILE`) while a server already holds that port adds FILE as a tab on the running server and exits; an open browser picks it up within a few seconds, and the default mode focuses the browser on it.
- A URL works wherever a path does (`mdrender https://github.com/o/r/blob/main/README.md`, also with `--port`, `POST /api/documents` and the MCP `start_server`/`open_tab`): it is downloaded under `/tmp/md-render/remote` (`MDRENDER_REMOTE_DIR` overrides; GitHub file pages fetch as raw; one directory `github.com-OWNER-REPO` per repository, so its files share a workspace) and opened from there. Naming a URL again re-opens the same tab; a refresh downloads it again. Saving an edit to a remote document also writes it to `~/.config/mdrender/temp_files/` (same layout; `MDRENDER_SAVED_DIR` overrides; `PUT /api/file` answers with `saved_copy`), and that copy is restored instead of downloading, on open and on refresh, until it is deleted. Limit 20 MB. Relative images in remote documents do not resolve.
- Server HTTP API: `GET /api/health` (identifies the app), `GET /api/files` (tab list; `?ws=<workspace>` scopes it to one workspace, `?refresh=true` rescans directory arguments), `GET /api/workspaces` (workspace names, directories and file counts), `GET /api/file?id=N` (content by opaque id), `GET /api/read?path=` and `PUT /api/file` (read/write an open document by path), `POST /api/export` (write comment-stripped copy), `GET /api/asset?path=` (images beside open documents only), `POST /api/documents` (add tabs; `ws` puts them into a named workspace under labels relative to it), `DELETE /api/file?id=N` (close a tab), `DELETE /api/workspaces?name=X` (close a workspace), `GET|PUT /api/view?ws=` (the tab and theme a workspace's pages should show, applied on their next poll), `POST /api/shutdown` (stop the server), `GET /api/experiments/projects`, `GET /api/experiments/runs?project=|db=&base=`, `POST /api/tikz` (compile a TikZ block; token required) and `GET /api/tikz/<key>.svg` (cached, immutable), `GET|POST /api/experiments/series` (runs, keys, `max_points`, `if_version`; JSON errors `{error, message}`); every mutation needs the token. Document ids are stable — closing a tab never renumbers the others — and a closed file stays closed across refreshes until it is explicitly added again.
- Writes require a bearer token the server injects into the served page and records in `$XDG_STATE_HOME/md-render/servers/<port>.json` (mode 0600). Reads and writes are limited to documents named at launch or added later; images only from those documents' directories; experiment databases read-only from the trackio directory and served folders; binds 127.0.0.1 unless `--host` is passed.
- MCP server: `mdrender --mcp` (stdio; register with `claude mcp add mdrender -- mdrender --mcp`) exposes list_servers/start_server/stop_server, list_workspaces/open_directory/close_workspace, list_tabs/open_tab/close_tab/refresh, read_document/write_document/add_comment/export_clean, focus_tab/set_theme, list_projects/list_runs/read_metrics (trackio experiment data for plot blocks), render_tikz (compile a TikZ block, return errors). Every result carries the browser URL; `port` is inferred when one server is live. Source under `mcp/`, bundled to one file by `npm run build:mcp`, installed to `~/.local/share/md-render/mcp/index.js`.
- Review comments are `<chat><comment>...</comment></chat>` blocks stored inline in the markdown after the passage they discuss; "Export clean .md" writes `NAME.clean.md` with the blocks stripped.
- Quiz blocks: `<quiz>question <enumerate><option>...</option><option>...</option></enumerate></quiz>` renders as a card with the options hidden until an eye button reveals them — useful for generated study material. An `<answer>...</answer>` block (inside a quiz or standalone) stays hidden until the reader clicks "Show answer", independently of the options.
- Experiment plots: `<plot>{JSON}</plot>` (or a ```plot fence) draws a chart from a trackio database (wandb-compatible; `$TRACKIO_DIR`, default `~/.cache/huggingface/trackio/<project>.db`). Fields: `plot_type` (line | bar | spider | histogram | scatter), `source` (`{"project": NAME}` or `{"db": PATH}` relative to the markdown file), `runs` / `metrics` (regex or list), `items` (explicit series with `legend_name`, `metadata` shown on hover, `style`), `views` (dropdown entries with `runs`, `metrics`, `group_by`: run | metric | none | config:<dotpath> | run:<regex capture>, `legend` template), `descriptions` (metric key or glob to text, shown on hover), `caption` (the lesson of the plot in one or two sentences with its numbers, not a description of the axes; shown under it as "Figure N: …", numbered in document order; inline markdown and math; give every plot one), `x`/`y` (axis step|time|relative, log scale, EMA smoothing), `summary`, `bins`, `scatter`, `refresh` (auto: every 15 s while the database changed in the last ten minutes), `table` (per-series summary table: shown automatically up to 150 rows; `true` forces it, `false` hides it). Without `views` the dropdown derives train-vs-val, family-components, per-key and by-config views from `split/family/name` keys. Databases open read-only; JSON stored as TEXT or BLOB and trackio schema 1 and 2 both read.
- TikZ diagrams: a ```tikz fence or `<tikz>…</tikz>` compiles to SVG with the built-in Tectonic LaTeX engine (no TeX install needed; tikz, tikz-cd, pgfplots, circuitikz and the rest of TeX Live), compiled in a child process limited to 20 s of CPU (`MDRENDER_TIKZ_TIMEOUT`) and cached by content hash under the user cache directory (`MDRENDER_TIKZ_CACHE`). Header lines `%! packages:`, `%! libraries:`, `%! preamble:`, `%! caption:` (caption shown as "Figure N: …", numbered with plots); a full `\documentclass` document is also accepted. Black follows the theme text colour, white the figure background. First use downloads TeX files once; `mdrender --warm-tikz` pre-fetches. MCP `render_tikz` compiles and returns TeX errors.
- Math is KaTeX, with MathJax-compatible source handling before rendering: `\(…\)` / `\[…\]` delimiters, bare `\begin{equation|align|gather|multline|eqnarray}` blocks (wrapped in `$$`), AMS numbering via inserted `\tag{n}` (one per equation, one per align/gather row, none with `\nonumber`/`\notag` or an explicit `\tag`), `\label{key}` recorded and removed, `\eqref{key}`/`\ref{key}` replaced by `(n)`. Code fences and inline code are left alone. The Plain, Ponder and Paradigm themes show display math unboxed, as those blogs do; the book themes keep it in a tinted panel.
- Docker: each release publishes `ghcr.io/aadityasalgarkar/md_render:<tag>` and `:latest`. `docker run -p 127.0.0.1:9999:9999 -v "$PWD:/docs" ghcr.io/aadityasalgarkar/md_render` serves /docs headless with TeX files baked in (trackio databases at /data/trackio, caches at /cache). On Linux, `curl -fsSL https://aadityasalgarkar.github.io/md_render/install.sh | MDRENDER_DOCKER=1 sh` (or `make install-docker`) installs without compiling: `~/.local/bin/md-render` becomes a script that runs the image with the home folder, /tmp and the state directory at their real paths, host network and host pids, as the user, so the wrapper, joining servers and MCP work unchanged (`MDRENDER_DOCKER_MOUNTS` adds directories, `MDRENDER_IMAGE` overrides the image).
- Install: `curl -fsSL https://aadityasalgarkar.github.io/md_render/install.sh | sh` (detects platform, clones, runs `make install`; no sudo), or clone and `make install` by hand. macOS: `MD_RENDER.app` + `~/bin/mdrender`. Linux: user-local under `~/.local` and `~/bin`, no root; `npm run tauri:build` also emits deb/rpm/AppImage.
- Build caveat: plain `cargo build --release` emits `target/release/app`, which expects a dev server and shows a blank window; the usable binary is `target/release/md-render` from `npm run tauri:build`.

- [README](https://github.com/AadityaSalgarkar/md_render/blob/main/README.md): condensed version of the above
- [skills.md](https://aadityasalgarkar.github.io/md_render/skills.md): drop-in agent skill for rendering and serving markdown with MD_RENDER

## Source

- [Repository](https://github.com/AadityaSalgarkar/md_render): MIT licensed
- [Releases](https://github.com/AadityaSalgarkar/md_render/releases): semver-tagged builds (dmg, deb, rpm, AppImage) with changelog; versions are cut automatically from conventional commits
- [src/App.tsx](https://github.com/AadityaSalgarkar/md_render/blob/main/src/App.tsx): layout, panes, document loading, autosave
- [src/lib/backend.ts](https://github.com/AadityaSalgarkar/md_render/blob/main/src/lib/backend.ts): the desktop/server backend abstraction
- [src/lib/themes.ts](https://github.com/AadityaSalgarkar/md_render/blob/main/src/lib/themes.ts): theme registry, single source of visual truth
- [src-tauri/src/server.rs](https://github.com/AadityaSalgarkar/md_render/blob/main/src-tauri/src/server.rs): axum server, asset allowlist, token checks
- [src-tauri/src/cli.rs](https://github.com/AadityaSalgarkar/md_render/blob/main/src-tauri/src/cli.rs): argument parsing and directory expansion
- [mcp/src](https://github.com/AadityaSalgarkar/md_render/tree/main/mcp/src): the MCP server — server discovery, HTTP client, one file per tool group
- [src-tauri/src/remote.rs](https://github.com/AadityaSalgarkar/md_render/blob/main/src-tauri/src/remote.rs): downloading markdown from a URL into /tmp, GitHub URL mapping
